WHAT_IS_SHARED_ON_PURPOSE: the endpoint definition and the trigger step and locked-daughter cell set at t_m. Two implementations of one definition is the point; in the campaign t_m and the daughter cells come from the fork runner and are identical in both arms by construction.

INDEPENDENCE_AUDIT.SCAN_METHOD: tokenized: comments and string literals removed before the search
INDEPENDENCE_AUDIT.CORRECTION: the first version of this audit scanned raw file text and reported ldfma01, c_cid and k_id as present, because the module docstring names them in order to promise it does not use them. Same false-positive class as the earlier bare-substring 'ties' matching inside 'identities'. Corrected here, not relaxed, and both scans are reported.

LAYER_1_FIXTURES.why_that_matters: a case where BOTH implementations are wrong in the same way is still caught, which a bare A-versus-B comparison would miss.
adversarial_cases_included: squared distance exactly equal to CORE_R squared
toroidal wrap in y, in x, and in both
an exact tie, which must terminate and must never be resolved by preference
a step where one identity survives and another does not

LAYER_2_DEVELOPMENTAL_WORLDS.the_available_set: the 22 developmental LAW_C_MCTT01 worlds that triggered, carried the identity to maturation and had the selective removal applied — TLMR01/work/raw22 on the device.

NEGATIVE_CONTROL.what: the four LAW_C worlds that triggered but did not carry the identity to maturation, so no removal was applied and classifier A emits no locked-daughter interval at all.
NEGATIVE_CONTROL.why_it_matters: agreement on 22 productions is weaker than agreement on 22 productions and 4 refusals. B invents no interval where A produces none, and refuses none where A produces one.

LAYER_3_SENSITIVITY.why: a comparison that cannot fail proves nothing. These mutations break classifier B on purpose and ask whether the qualification notices.

ONE_SIDED_BLIND_ZONE_FOUND.observation: shrinking CORE_R squared by as little as 0.001 is caught; enlarging it by 0.1 is not.
ONE_SIDED_BLIND_ZONE_FOUND.explanation: cell separations are integers, so no squared distance lies in the open interval (25, 26); centroid separations lie on a quarter-integer squared lattice, so none lies in (25, 25.25). An enlargement inside those gaps cannot admit a pair and therefore cannot change any answer.
ONE_SIDED_BLIND_ZONE_FOUND.falsifiable_prediction_made_and_tested: the link layer must stay blind at +0.24 and must become sensitive at exactly +0.25
ONE_SIDED_BLIND_ZONE_FOUND.conclusion: the blind zone is provably empty of realisable configurations. The test is complete over the reachable space, not merely one-sided.

LAYER_3_SENSITIVITY.LINK_RULE_MUTATION: resolving a split by preference instead of terminating — the single most dangerous silent change available — produced 9 link disagreements and was caught.

DECLARED_WINDOW_ASYMMETRY: duration counts rows t_m+1..end; exposure sums rows t_m..end.  This is not an off-by-one: the archive writes a cell row AFTER the step, so the occupancy on row t is the population that a decay at step t+1 acts on.  An exposure window that starts at row t_m is therefore the correct driver for events at steps t_m+1..end+1, and it is the convention under which LDFMA01's Poisson map read 5.809 predicted against 5 observed.  The duration counts post-intervention steps and starts one row later.  Both quantities are reported; the symmetric variant is reported beside the frozen one so the difference is measured, not assumed away.

SYMMETRIC_EXPOSURE_VARIANT_ALSO_COMPUTED.what: B also reports the exposure summed over rows t_m+1..end, the variant that matches the duration window.
SYMMETRIC_EXPOSURE_VARIANT_ALSO_COMPUTED.NOT_A_SUBSTITUTION: the frozen endpoint is unchanged. The variant is published so the size of the convention is measured rather than argued about, and so that a checker can see it without recomputing anything.

WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_DO: it qualifies the instrument, not the hypothesis. Two implementations agreeing means the endpoint is computed reproducibly; it says nothing about whether parent removal affects the locked daughter.
